Slack Shopify Airbnb Linear Stripe Slack Shopify Airbnb When to use A “Trusted by” or “Used by teams at” strip under a hero or above pricing Showing more customer, partner or integration logos than fit in one static row When not to use Three to five logos – a static, centred row reads calmer and needs no motion Logos people need to compare or click through – use a grid; a moving target is hard to hit Installation Add Logo Marquee with the shadcn CLI – your project needs a components.json, see Installation in the docs – or copy the file by hand. Requires React 19. CLI Manual pnpm npm yarn bun Copy pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://www.affectui.com/r/logo-marquee.json Usage example.tsx Copy import { LogoMarquee } from "@/components/ui/logo-marquee"; import { VercelMark, LinearMark, StripeMark, FigmaMark, NotionMark, GitHubMark } from "./marks"; const logos = [ { name: "Vercel", svg: , scale: 0.86 }, { name: "Linear", svg: , color: "#5E6AD2" }, { name: "Stripe", svg: , color: "#635BFF", href: "/customers/stripe" }, { name: "Figma", svg: , color: "#F24E1E" }, { name: "Notion", svg: }, { name: "GitHub", svg: }, ]; export function TrustedBy() { return (

Off shows full colour and dims the others on hover labels "none" | "below" | "beside" "none" Show the brand name as a small caption under the mark, or beside it like a wordmark label string "Logos of companies using the product" Accessible name of the strip className string – Extra class on the wrapper Keyboard interactions Tab Moves through linked logos; the strip stops and the focused logo is nudged into view Accessibility A labelled region; each name is read once – the repeated copies that make the loop are aria-hidden and inert Keyboard focus stops the strip so a logo never runs away from the focus ring Hover and focus stop it too, which covers the WCAG pause requirement for moving content Reduced motion shows every logo in a static, wrapping row Motion The loop repeats a measured set and wraps by exactly its width – no gap, no jump One requestAnimationFrame loop eases a velocity per row: hover slows it to a stop, leaving winds it back up Drag or swipe to scrub; letting go flings it with inertia before it settles back into its own pace Only runs while on screen; edges fade out with a mask Responsive behavior Container queries make logos and gaps smaller in narrow containers, down to 320px without page overflow Touch: horizontal swipes scrub the strip, vertical swipes still scroll the page Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually ) has the class dark or data-theme="dark" Performance Transforms only – no layout work per frame, and no React re-renders while it runs Related Logo Cluster Card illustrations Your mark on a white disc in the middle – company logos bounce out of it and settle around it Text Reveal Text Text that arrives word by word or letter by letter – each piece rises out of a soft blur as it scrolls into view Gradient Text Text Letters cut from a liquid, ever-flowing gradient – the color sweeps across the word the first time it's seen affectUI · 54 components · 12 screens · 11 blocks · 24 illustrations · 8 motion effects affectUI Agent-ready React UI for AI products – one file each, no dependencies.
